feature.summary: Makes a PDF from text. On Web the assistant has a file tool that builds a PDF from a title and markdown-like text, and artifacts have a 'Download as PDF' action for documents and slide decks. Mobile exports documents and decks to PDF on the device. Word, spreadsheet or slide file conversion to PDF was not found.

purpose.what_it_does: Produces a downloadable PDF from text content. The Web tool takes a filename, a title and up to 100,000 characters (apps/web/lib/services/managed-office-file-service.ts:190-197) and lays them out on A4 pages with 20 mm margins using a PDF library (managed-office-file-service.ts:796-822). Artifact and deck PDFs are made in the browser (apps/web/features/chat/components/artifacts/ArtifactPreview.tsx:1642-1666).
purpose.why_it_exists: Brief S31.01 to S31.03 want text documents, spreadsheets and slide decks turned into PDF (doc: knowledge-base/data/area-briefs/031-pdf-and-document-transformation-products.md). People expect to receive a real file.
purpose.who_uses_it: Web, Mobile and Tauri desktop users who ask for a PDF or press a download button.
problems_solved: Sharing a chat answer or report as a file
Printing or sending a slide deck as PDF
use_cases: Ask 'make a PDF of this report'
Open a document artifact and choose 'Download as PDF'
Open a slide-deck artifact and download it as a PDF
On a phone, export an artifact as PDF from the export sheet

steps.what_happens: Person asks for a PDF; the server detects creation intent and adds the file tool to the turn
The chat model calls the tool with filename, title and content
The server validates and builds the PDF in process with jsPDF
If verify_render is set, a sandbox converts and rasterises it for a receipt; with no sandbox the call fails
The file is attached to the reply for download

corrections.claim: Pipe tables: PDF layout lines read handle headings and bullets only; table output not confirmed
corrections.what_the_code_shows: generatePdf has an explicit table branch: isTableRow, skips dividers and writes cells joined with '   |   '.
corrections.correction: The PDF tool renders pipe tables as plain text lines with ' | ' separators (no grid), and skips the divider row. Headings, bullets, numbered lines and tables are all handled.

corrections.claim: Web tool: PDF with title, headings (#), bullets and numbered lines, wrapped on A4 pages (796-822)
corrections.what_the_code_shows: A4 wrap, headings (#{1,3}) and bullets/numbered lines are correct, but the function runs to about line 842, and the table branch sits after line 822. Margin constant PDF_MARGIN_MM is used (page's '20 mm' not checked here).

corrections.claim: Generated PDF (tool path) stored in: unknown; file size cap MAX_GENERATED_FILE_BYTES value not read; file attached to reply, 'storage path not traced'
corrections.what_the_code_shows: The tool loop persists the bytes with persistGeneratedFileBytes (provider 'agi-managed-office', origin 'managed-office-tool', tied to conversationId) and returns file name/uri/mime/byte_count plus generatedFiles. The cap is 20 * 1024 * 1024 bytes (20 MiB); larger output is rejected, and the reply is 'The Office file could not be attached.' when persistence fails.
corrections.correction: The tool-created PDF is saved through persistGeneratedFileBytes and attached to the conversation; the cap is 20 MiB. Remove these from Unknown.

corrections.claim: Model compatibility: Needs a model that can call tools [inferred]; Permissions/limits: none found
corrections.what_the_code_shows: Not inferred. The server rejects office creation with 422 office_creation_stream_required when the request is not streaming, and 422 office_creation_model_unsupported when the resolved model has tools === false.
corrections.correction: Web PDF creation requires a streaming chat request and a tool-capable model; otherwise HTTP 422 with those codes.

corrections.claim: Tauri desktop: document_create_pdf tool via printpdf; text from the user
corrections.what_the_code_shows: The executor needs app_handle and takes output_path (required), optional title and author, and a required non-empty string array 'paragraphs' (not text/markdown), then calls document_create_pdf_simple. Page implies same text/markdown input as Web.
corrections.correction: The Tauri tool takes output_path, title, author and a paragraphs list and writes to a local path on the device; no markdown headings or bullets.

corrections.claim: Subscription: Sandbox render check depends on managed compute and provisioning gates (gate.ts:15-30)
corrections.what_the_code_shows: e2bExecutionEnabled is true with an E2B_API_KEY OR the flag =1 (lines 9-13); provisioning needs flag=1 AND key AND sandboxComputeIsPriceable (23-30). The managed-compute beta gate is a separate gate, not required for e2bExecutionEnabled. No plan check appears in these lines.
corrections.correction: Render check availability is an environment gate (key or AGI_E2B_EXECUTION=1; provisioning also needs priceable compute). The beta gate is separate.

missing_facts: Tool-created files are persisted and attached to the conversation through persistGeneratedFileBytes, capped at 20 MiB (apps/web/app/api/llm/v1/chat/completions/lib/tool-loop.ts:2575-2606; apps/web/lib/server/generated-file-persist.ts:17,242). The page lists this as unknown.

Web PDF creation requires stream:true and a tool-capable model, else HTTP 422 office_creation_stream_required / office_creation_model_unsupported (apps/web/app/api/llm/v1/chat/completions/lib/request-processor.ts:5460-5490).

The PDF generator renders pipe tables as ' | ' text rows (apps/web/lib/services/managed-office-file-service.ts:837-841); the Tauri tool takes a paragraphs array and output_path rather than markdown (apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/core/llm/tool_executor/document_tools.rs:321-347).
